bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public health; appropriating money for a Produce Rx pilot program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; PRODUCE RX PILOT PROGRAM.

$410,300 in fiscal year 2026 and $410,300 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for a grant to the city of Minneapolis to sustain and expand its produce prescription pilot program, Produce Rx, to programs at ten federally qualified health centers and school-based clinics in Hennepin and Olmsted Counties. The base for this appropriation is $410,300 in fiscal years 2028, 2029, and 2030, and $0 in fiscal year 2031.
additions: $410,300 in fiscal year 2026 and $410,300 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for a grant to the city of Minneapolis to sustain and expand its produce prescription pilot program, Produce Rx, to programs at ten federally qualified health centers and school-based clinics in Hennepin and Olmsted Counties. The base for this appropriation is $410,300 in fiscal years 2028, 2029, and 2030, and $0 in fiscal year 2031.
